issues.detail: data-platform.md is only ~25 lines, so a run that opens it with a plain Read sees the whole file even if it applies none of it. Whether that counts as 'loading' is a judge call the case leaves open; the fixture supplies distinctive guidance below the Read when line so application is still observable in the plan.
issues.fix: Judge should weigh application (plan content) alongside how far the file was read.

issues.detail: Catalog marked assertion 3 deterministic_complete, but the spec uses complete:false with only a path-after-Plan-Notes regex, leaving exclusion of data-platform.md to the judge. This is looser, not stricter, and cannot fail a correct run.

summary: Every stated condition is realized: a coherent brownfield STANDARD cycle at DEVELOPING with complete scope, design, and context, Development NONE, and two project references whose exact Read when lines match the case, with distinctive guidance only in the matching one and no hints in the design. Checks are necessary conditions a correct PROPOSED-plan run satisfies (plan provenance, Status PROPOSED, User Style Locked false, BlockedOn set, no implementation/upstream edits), check.mjs is clean, and the standard invariants fit.
